card.name: Words just before an O-drug or term
card.fires_on: Small linking words or a lone "O" in drug-label highlights and section text, right before the next word begins with O or a similar term (Ovarian, Ocular, Olanzapine, OATP).

modes.label: Lone O starting a word
modes.description: The letter O is split off as its own piece at the start of a word such as Ovarian, Ocular, Olanzapine or OATP.

modes.label: Linking word mid-sentence
modes.description: A connector such as containing, or, of, or a comma in a clause of safety or trial text.

card.plain: It fires at the joints just before a new term starts, often a drug or condition beginning with O.
